statement: A boundary is not bound: a tenant or app binding that names a platform boundary is refused when it is checked (422 REFERENCES), as the data plane would find no policy of that id, and the grant analysis reads a boundary as no policy at all.

control:BoundaryReferencesTest#an app does not bind a platform boundary either
